title: AULIBS package consumer manifest
description: Every package folder under ts/ or go/ carries a used-by.json validating against this schema. It names the repositories that consume the package, so an agent changing the package knows what it may break.

package.description: This package's path within the repository, e.g. "ts/apmap".

consumers.description: Repositories that consume this package. Empty is valid and is the normal state of a package nobody has adopted yet.

repo.description: The consuming sibling repository's folder name, e.g. "auto-pigeon".

usage.description: One line on what that repository uses this package for.

added.description: Date the consumer adopted the package, ISO 8601 calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD).
